title: Startup sues Apple in India over tap-to-share contacts feature
summary: A U.S. startup is seeking $162 million in damages and an injunction to impact iPhone and Apple Watch imports to India.
llm_summary: A U.S. startup has filed a lawsuit in India accusing Apple of infringing its patented “tap‑to‑share contacts” technology used in iPhones and Apple Watches. The company is demanding $162 million in damages and is asking the court to block imports of the devices into India until
